description: Paid ($0.005 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): the pre-payment check for up to 10 x402 endpoints at once. Per endpoint go, caution or no_go, the recommended payment option and why, plus totals. For marketplaces and agents that weigh several services. Never pays the endpoints. Same as GET /api/v1/preflight/batch. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

client.description: Set to gateway when your agent pays with Circle's Gateway client (@circle-fin/x402-batching) from a Gateway balance: Gateway-only endpoints are then not a caution, and Gateway options are recommended first.

max_usd.description: Your budget per call in USD, e.g. 0.05

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

network.description: CAIP-2 network you want to pay on, e.g. eip155:8453

urls.description: The x402 endpoints to check (public http(s) URLs), at most 10

name: x402_preflight_batch

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

counts.description: How many go, caution, no_go and unknown

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the answer to your arguments

title: Check up to 10 x402 endpoints before paying ($0.005 via x402)
